note: A plain cut at max_length passes the visible tests; hidden tests cover the word-boundary rule at its edges, the suffix that has to fit inside max_length, and the unchanged slug rules.

twin_breaks.rule: it is shortened to the longest run of whole leading words that fits in `max_length` characters
With `max_length`, the whole result, suffix included, is at most `max_length` characters. The base is shortened by rules 2 to 4 to `max_length` minus the length of the suffix
When a suffix leaves less than one character for the base, `ValueError` is raised
